title: draft_curated_playlist
description: Discover candidate videos and build an immutable, expiring constrained playlist draft without modifying YouTube (FR-5.1, FR-5.1a, FR-5.2, FR-5.3, FR-6.2, read only).

topic.description: Topic or learning query used to search and rank candidate videos.

target_total_minutes.description: Target total duration T in minutes; valid drafts stay within [T * (1 - tolerance), T] and never exceed T.

tolerance_percent.description: Allowed percentage below target_total_minutes (default 5.0 percent; total duration never exceeds target_total_minutes).

max_video_minutes.description: Optional inclusive maximum duration per individual video in minutes.

max_videos.description: Upper bound on the number of selected videos (default 25; never treated as an exact required count).

language.description: Optional BCP 47 spoken language code checked solely on primary subtag against snippet.defaultAudioLanguage.

allow_unknown_language.description: Explicitly allow videos without snippet.defaultAudioLanguage when filtering by language, labelled Audio language unverified.

title.description: Optional title proposed for the playlist draft shown during trusted confirmation.

privacy_status.description: Playlist privacy setting to apply upon confirmed creation (default private).
